d:
Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ke avsar par samaroh sthal par ghurdaur pratiyogita aayojit ki ja rahi hai. ghurdaur dekhne ke lie umri bhir aur logon ke utsah ne sabhi ka dhyan khincha hai.
Ghurdaur dekhne ke lie tavar par charhe log, bhari bhir
Anant sinh ke yahan chal rahi is ghurdaur pratiyogita ko dekhne ke lie bari sankhya men log pahunche hain. kaee log daur ka najara dekhne ke lie tavar par charh gae, jabki pure ilake men darshakon ki bhari bhir najar aa rahi hai. is vidiyo men dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men ghurdaur pratiyogita aur umri bhir ki riporta.
